_comment: Robot presets for the motion study (microduck/variant.py). 'comb' is the robot as generated in robot/microduck.xml. Any other preset changes it for comparison. Plate rectangles are millimetres in the shin frame: x forward from the knee axis, y outboard.

comb.description: The robot as generated: comb soles whose fingers cross the centre line.

flat_feet.description: Comparison: the same robot with the flat sole plates as first drawn (75 by 48 by 5 mm) in place of the comb soles, the hip roll limits those soles had, and no leg clearance rule.
